reviews.x: 2/16/16 - Eyelash Growth Serum for Long Eyelashes From Uptown Cosmeceuticals  This is truly amazing stuff!  First, let me say, no one has bribed me, coerced me, or given me freebies or a discount for my review. This is my honest experience since I received this product in January 2016.  I have always had short eyelashes. When I've used an eyelash curler in the past, my eyelashes looked nice to those standing directly in front of me, but from the side, my lashes looked unnaturally and abruptly tu

I have been using this for about three weeks now. I have followed the instructions, what little there are, explicitly. I haven't really noticed a difference. I'm going to diligently use it for another two weeks, and I'll change my review if my results change.  But, I would like to say that the product container and box were not exceptionally professional looking. Also, there are a LARGE number of paid/discounted reviews on this product. I was suspicious about that when I initially ordered it. Bu

The shipping was very fast from this company and I like the personal emails the company sends directly to you.  I bought this product after wearing Eyelash Extensions for about 3 months.  I removed the extensions and my eyelashes were much shorter than what they were before I tried the extensions.  Don't believe when they say wearing extensions will not damage your regular lashes.  Mine were extremely short and very thin.  I was excited to use this product to hopefully get my eyelashes to grow f

I had used 2 more expensive products and had grown very long lashes. I purchased this hoping to at least maintain my lashes for a month or so and save some $$. Unfortunately my eyelashes did not grow and the product made them brittle. After using for about 3 weeks I have short brittle lashes that look terrible. I won't use it again and am glad I didn't buy for my friends.

reviews.t: I don't like leaving negative comments
reviews.x: I don't like leaving negative comments. However, when a product doesn't do what it claims, I want to be honest. I've been using this serum for 2 weeks religiously morning and night and see absolutely no results. I will keep at it for a couple more weeks. Hope this wasn't a waist of money.

I was a lattisse user for quite some time before switching to this product. The reviews and kiss coat sold me! However after only using this product a few days I noticed lashes falling out. No way was I going to try it a day more. Back to lattisse I go..

reviews.t: Do not waste your time or money
reviews.x: Do not waste your time or money. These reviews are most likely paid reviews. I purchased two bottles, and used it religiously. No difference at all.

reviews.t: Well, I tried. Did not give me the ...
reviews.x: Well, I tried. Did not give me the growth results others have had. One or two things I noticed: my lashes were a bit darker and curlier plus they did not fall out as much. Aside from that I did not notice much effect. One caution, whatever you do DON'T get this is your eyes - it really stings and I am not a pain pansy. It has be washed out immediately.
Eyelashes fell out and it burned my eyes so I returned it.

reviews.t: This just might be the lash serum of my dreams.
reviews.x: I just got this a couple of weeks ago and didn't start using it right away. I'd gotten out of the routine of using lash serum, so I had to remind myself to use it. Well, now that I've been using it consistently, I can honestly say it's at least as good as the high priced serums I'd used in the past (Revitalash and Latisse). My lashes are already starting to show the results. It's a record.  With prior products, I had to wait much longer to see visible growth. I can actually feel them touching my

This is the second brand of eyelash growth serum I've tried, and decided to try this brand because it was considerably cheaper.  This is another example of "you get what you pay for". In the past I have used Rapidlash.  I was amazed at how long and full my lashes were after only a few weeks.  I'd say it took about 3 weeks for it to really show, and the results were amazing.  Over time I got a little lazy and took my new full, long lashes for granted and stopped using Rapidlash.  Graduall

reviews.t: I am sold on this product!
reviews.x: I have been using it once a day for only 2 weeks and am already seeing results.  I am especially excited about my eyebrows.  They are thicker and darker!  I am 62, and my brows and eyelashes had thinned over the years.  I used Latisse before.  It worked, but I had to wait about 5 weeks before there was a noticeable difference, and I could not afford to stay on it for long, so I had really given up on the idea of having thick long lashes again.  But this product works every bit as well as Latisse

reviews.t: The product does darken my lashes and eyebrows. However ...
reviews.x: The product does darken my lashes and eyebrows. However I see no new growth of eyelashes. They are not any longer. I use it every night. My eyebrows  are hard to judge since they are darker. It seems there is some spots filled in. I'm afraid I will run out of this before I see any real changes. If I don't see any more changes before it's gone, I probably wouldn't order more at that price, just to see if it just takes longer for me.

I waited 2 weeks to post this review. It really works!! I have never been able to use an eyelash curler since my lashes were too short. Not a problem now. The directions read not to use on lower lashes but I tried it anyway and my lower lashes have grown significantly as well. Even though I haven't used all of the other one I have already ordered another. Didn't irritate my eyes and was easy to apply. I highly recommend.

I never write reviews because most things are as expected.  However, this product is different - I applied on Sunday and then Monday as directed have not done so the last 2 days because I have had the worst eye irritation and inflammation.  I am considering having to go to the eye doctor because nothing seems to make it stop.  There is only one place for this product - the trash can.  I am considering notifying the FDA.

I wanted to like this product, but I don't.  I have used many eyelash growth products, including Revitalash, Grandelash, and Rapidlash.  I used this faithfully for 3 months  every night and saw no difference whatsoever.  I was looking for something that was a bit less expensive and given the great reviews I thought I would give it a try.  No luck.  I would say to spend a bit more and get the Rapidlash.

I really like this stuff. I have seen a significant difference in the length of my eyelashes plus a little more fullness, and I used it to fill/darken my eyebrows and it's done exactly what I needed.  Took maybe 2 weeks to start really seeing significant results. I stopped using it for a time (left it home while travelling) and didn't see the results really wear off. Very pleased!

reviews.t: Provider was great.  Product results VERY disappointing.
reviews.x: I switched to this product after using Rapid Lash.  Not sure why I switched but after using this product my lashes actually shrunk from the progress I had  made with RL!  Oh, and it caused my eyes to sting and water after application.  The provider of the product was fast and efficient and I have no issues with them.

I've tried a few in the past.  This is the first one I've experienced so much displeasure with.  It's too watery and even after a couple swipes on the side it still finds it's way in my eyes.  I'll not be purchasing this one again.  I'm still waiting to see the results and I've been using it for a few weeks now.

claims.text: Many users report seeing no growth results after weeks of use.
Some users experienced eyelash loss or brittleness while using the product.
Several reviewers report burning, stinging, or eyelid irritation from the product.
Some users report positive results, comparing it favorably to prescription serums like Latisse.
Reviewers express suspicion that many positive reviews are paid or incentivized.

qa.q: Does it actually work, and how long until I see results?
qa.answer: Yes, most reviewers report it works, with results often appearing around 2 weeks [1][2][3][4], though one reviewer saw little growth effect [5].

claims.text: One reviewer saw results in only 2 weeks, with thicker and darker eyebrows [1].
Another reviewer saw significant results in maybe 2 weeks [2].
A reviewer waited 2 weeks and reported it really works [3].
After two weeks, a reviewer was glad to report positive results [4].
One reviewer did not get the growth results others had, only slightly darker and curlier lashes [5].

qa.q: Is it safe for sensitive eyes or contact lens wearers?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Are there side effects like irritation or darkening of the eyelids?
qa.answer: Yes, reviews report irritation: one user had severe eye irritation and inflammation [1], and another had stinging with red, irritated eyelids [2]. Reviews also mention darkening of lashes and eyebrows [4][5], but not specifically darkening of the eyelids.

claims.text: One user reported the worst eye irritation and inflammation [1].
Another user reported stinging and red, irritated eyelids [2].
Reviews mention darkening of lashes and eyebrows [4][5].

qa.q: How do I apply it, and how long does one bottle last?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is it worth the price compared to other lash serums?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on value: some say it performs as well as pricier serums [2][5], while others found no results and recommend spending more on Rapidlash [1][6].

claims.text: It is at least as good as high-priced serums like Revitalash and Latisse [2], and achieves like results for those who can't afford the prescription version [5].
Others saw no difference and advise spending a bit more on Rapidlash [1][6].
